_what: The EMITTED NR-V04 retrospective R1 verdict, copied verbatim from the lane's durable collect readout. NOT the preregistered scoring description — that is nrv04-retro-criteria-audit.json, which says what the test WOULD do, not what it DID.
_scorer: nrv04_retro_gate.verdict (frozen), applied by nrv04_vast_launch.retro_collect. Nothing in this file is recomputed here.
_amendment: The authorized panel is AMENDMENT 4's: 16 legs, model-level n = 3 / 3 / 2. Read every reference set below against §4.3, not against the pre-amendment enumeration.

nonconforming_records.why: mode='smoke', not 'run' — a smoke leg runs 500 steps with NO equilibration (nrv04_covalent_md.run_leg) and cannot carry the preregistered endpoint

verdict.endpoint: E1 interface-RMSD plateau (A); lower = more stable
verdict.reason: NR4A1 is not the most stable arm
verdict.pairwise_caveat: descriptive support, never the verdict (prereg §4c). Min attainable one-sided p per test: retro_noncov_nr4a2 = 0.05 (C(6,3) = 20 arrangements); retro_noncov_nr4a3 = 0.1 (C(5,3) = 10 arrangements) — ⛔ ABOVE α = 0.05, so this comparison CANNOT ATTAIN SIGNIFICANCE at any observed ordering and is UNRESOLVABLE, not null
verdict.leave_one_model_out_role: REPORTED robustness diagnostic only — NOT a tier condition (AMENDMENT 3 defect 3: 228,543 configurations reached p <= alpha with the correct ordering and zero failed LOMO, so the clause could never bite).
verdict.extension_rule: prereg §4d as corrected by AMENDMENT 3 defect 2: right sign but p in (0.05, 0.12] -> generate 3 more co-fold models per paralogue and re-run R1 at n=6. May NOT be invoked on a wrong-sign result.

registered_mde.source: nrv04-retrospective-prespend-audit-2026-07-25.md §3d — Monte-Carlo through THIS frozen decision rule; false-positive rate at delta=0 is 0.048, so the test is valid, just blunt
registered_mde.null_licenses: the workflow did not resolve a paralogue difference of the magnitude this design can detect (>= ~1.5-2.0 A in interface-RMSD plateau at n = 3 models/arm)
registered_mde.null_may_NOT_claim: that NR-V04's selectivity is localised to warhead reactivity. That localisation stands on Leg 0 (Cys551 unique to NR4A1) and Zhang 2018 and must be stated as such. AMENDMENT 3 defect 4 also retires prereg §5c's registered composite outcome, whose R2 half no longer exists.

verdict.claim_ceiling: directional concordance/discordance ONLY. No ddG, alpha, cooperativity, affinity or degradation claim; Arm E computes no free energy (prereg §6). A null is bounded by `registered_mde` (AMENDMENT 3 defect 4), not by the absence of an effect.
